functions.name: attribute_sol_deposit
functions.doc:
Attributes a Streamflow stream sitting at the caller's deposit address
 `dep/<caller>/<class_id>` to the caller: derives the address from the MPC contract, then
 proves the stream metadata and its mint with one ForeignTx `AccountState` request at
 `Finalized`. The class need not exist yet (the first deposit of a class creates it at
 registration): `class_id` only selects the derivation path, and the class the stream
 lands in is recomputed from the attested metadata. The stream must already have the
 vault-compatible flags (non-cancelable, non-transferable by the sender, transferable by
 the recipient, no automatic withdrawal, not pausable, no rate update, no top-up, no
 Streamflow or partner fee), a mint without a freeze authority (whoever holds it could
 freeze the vault's token account) and at least one whole token left to lock; otherwise it is
 recorded as refused at the deposit address and returnable to `return_to`. A stream
 already moved, registered or refused at the vault cannot be attributed. Anyone owning a
 NEAR account; attach exactly [`RECORD_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`] (kept with the record, returned
 when nothing is recorded) and 120 Tgas (the call keeps 80 Tgas for its chain). The app
 passes the account bytes it read at `finalized` right before the call.

functions.name: bootstrap
functions.doc:
Fills the MPC-derived foreign addresses once: `vault/base` (domain 0, the RoseVault
 signer), `vault/sol` and `gas/sol` (domain 1), read from the MPC contract's
 `derived_public_key` for this account. Anyone, once; a second call after the addresses
 are stored is refused, and a failed request can be retried. Attach 80 Tgas.

functions.name: cancel_no_key
functions.doc:
Cancels a round whose key has not arrived by `closes_at + key_timeout`, once no key
 request is in flight ([`KEY_REQUEST_FLIGHT_BLOCKS`] after the last `close`). Anyone.
 Every escrow, bond and locked unit becomes refundable through `settle_bid`. A round
 without orders is recorded as empty, as `close` would record it.

functions.name: cancel_round
functions.doc:
Cancels a round before its first bid. Only the creator, never after `closes_at`. Refunds
 the issuer escrow (Tender) and returns the encumbered units (Advance); the round's storage
 deposit stays with its record, which remains as public history.

functions.name: claim_base_tokens
functions.doc:
Claims `amount` unlocked tokens of a Base class to the EVM address `to`: debits the
 source, then asks the MPC to sign RoseVault `Transfer(token, to, amount, id)`; the
 signature is stored in the payout and the claimant submits `executeTransfer`. Holdings
 and lien shares are the caller's; a retired lot is payable by anyone to its `retire_to`
 address only. Attach the payout storage deposit and 80 Tgas (the call keeps 50 Tgas for
 the signature request and its callback).

functions.name: claim_sol_tokens
functions.doc:
Claims unlocked tokens of a Solana class to `to_owner`'s existing associated token
 account. The caller names the streams of the class to draw on (`draws`, at most what each
 can pay now: unlocked minus accounted withdrawals; at least one whole token per stream
 unless the draw empties it; a stream with an unconfirmed payout, or within
 [`SOL_DRAW_CUTOFF_SECS`] of its end, cannot be drawn on) and what to take from the
 class's swept balance (`swept`, at most `get_sol_swept(class).available`); the claimed
 amount is their sum. The engine debits the source, proves the caller's durable nonce and
 receipt nonce accounts (authority = vault, addresses derived with seeds bound to the
 caller, neither reserved by another unsettled action, see [`SolNonceProof`]) and the
 recipient's token account (initialized, of the class mint, owned by `to_owner`) with
 one ForeignTx request, then has `vault/sol` and `gas/sol` sign `AdvanceNonceAccount`,
 one Streamflow `withdraw` per draw, `TransferChecked` of the sum and the receipt's
 `AdvanceNonceAccount`. The payout stays `Signed` until `confirm_sol_payout`. Attach the
 payout storage deposit and 200 Tgas (the call keeps 105 Tgas for its chain).

functions.name: clear
functions.doc:
Clears a round once its reveal window is over. Anyone. Unopened orders are void (bond
 slashed at settlement); the clearing price and every fill are computed from the opened,
 valid orders and stored. The round becomes `Settled`, or `Cancelled` when nothing
 crosses. A Tender's issuer is refunded `escrow - charged - fee(charged)` here; an
 Advance's units move into a lien here.

functions.name: close
functions.doc:
Requests the round key from the MPC (CKD, `AppPublicKeyPV` with the round's public
 scalar, 1 yoctoNEAR paid by the engine). Anyone, once `now >= closes_at`; callable again
 while no key has arrived (the key is deterministic) until `closes_at + key_timeout`, when
 the round becomes cancellable instead. A round without any sealed order is cancelled
 instead: there is nothing to reveal. Attach 80 Tgas: a call with less than 60 Tgas left
 for the request and its callback is refused before anything changes.

functions.name: compute_base_class_id
functions.doc:

 or the refusal reason. Pure, for the app.

functions.name: compute_sol_class_id
functions.doc:
The class id a Streamflow stream of `mint` with `decimals` decimals lands in, or the
 refusal reason. Pure, for the app (and the deposit path `dep/<account>/<class>`).

functions.name: confirm_sol_payout
functions.doc:
Settles a signed Solana payout once its durable nonce advanced (the transaction can no
 longer execute): one ForeignTx `AccountState` request at `Finalized` proves the nonce
 account (`nonce_data`, its value must differ from the signed one) and the receipt nonce
 account (`receipt_data`). A receipt holding the nonce's new value proves the transaction
 executed (only it advances the receipt, and it leaves both accounts on the value of the
 block it executed in): the payout is `Landed` and its withdrawals count. A receipt behind
 the nonce proves the transaction failed on chain or its cancellation executed; that
 verdict needs two such proofs, the second requested at least
 [`super::CONFIRM_FAILURE_DELAY_BLOCKS`] after the first one's answer (the nodes read each
 account separately, and a lagging read of the receipt right after the landing must not
 pass for "did not execute"), then the claim is refunded. Both accounts stay reserved to
 the payout until then, so no other engine-signed transaction can move either.
 `anchor_tx` is any successful finalized transaction not newer than the reads (the
 payout's own transaction when it succeeded). Anyone; attach 100 Tgas. Bytes are hex,
 read at `finalized`.

functions.name: confirm_sol_redeem
functions.doc:
Settles the signed release of a Solana position once its durable nonce advanced, with the
 same proof and verdict as [`Self::confirm_sol_payout`]: a receipt holding the nonce's new
 value proves the release executed, the burn is final and the position `Released`; a
 receipt behind it on two proofs [`super::CONFIRM_FAILURE_DELAY_BLOCKS`] apart proves it
 did not, the units come back to the redeemer (accruing from the burn), so do the
 claimable tokens it paid, and the position is `Held` again. Anyone; attach 100 Tgas.
 Bytes are hex, read at `finalized`.

functions.name: create_advance
functions.doc:
Creates an Advance: the caller encumbers `units` of its holding until the round ends and
 sells a senior claim on their first `claim` unlocked tokens. The caller places its sealed
 reserve with `place_ask(round, ciphertext, claim)`. Attaches `ROUND_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`.
 Returns the round id.

functions.name: create_exit
functions.doc:
Creates an Exit round over `class_id`. Anyone; attaches `ROUND_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`. Returns
 the round id.

functions.name: create_tender
functions.doc:
Creates a Tender: the caller is the issuer, escrows `budget + fee(budget)` of its cash
 in `venue` and attaches `ROUND_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`. Returns the round id.

functions.doc: Fee-payer re-signature callback. Called by the contract itself.

functions.name: on_sol_nonce_verified
functions.doc:
Payout proof callback: on a matching attestation consumes the nonce value and requests
 the joined `vault/sol` and `gas/sol` signatures; otherwise refunds the debit and clears
 the nonce (nothing was signed). A callback for a payout no longer waiting for its proof
 changes nothing. Called by the contract itself.

functions.name: on_sol_signed
functions.doc:
Joined signature callback: stores the signatures that verify against their keys and
 assembles the transaction once both exist (`Signed`), or keeps a vault signature whose
 fee-payer counterpart is missing (`AwaitingGasSignature`). A failed authority request
 (`PromiseError`) never refunds a durable-nonce action, since a late signature of it could
 still surface and execute: the action is cancelled instead by a transaction that only
 advances the nonce (signed through `retry_sol_payout`, open at once), and its confirmation
 settles it. A failed move or return (recent blockhash, nothing debited) is marked failed.
 An unreadable response leaves the action `Requested` for `submit_sol_signature` or a retry
 after the expiry. Called by the contract itself.

functions.name: on_sol_stream_synced
functions.doc:
Sync callback: books the withdrawal when the attestation matches and the stream is still
 free to sync. Called by the contract itself.

functions.name: open_bid
functions.doc:
Opens a sealed order with its `(plaintext, sigma)` opening (48 and 32 bytes, hex). Anyone,
 during the reveal window. The identity, bidder and side come from the stored bid, never
 from the caller. The opening is fully verified; a valid opening whose values break the
 bid's collateral marks it void. Costs about 124 to 132 Tgas: attach 200 Tgas.

functions.name: payouts_total
functions.doc: Number of signed actions so far (the next EIP-712 id).

functions.name: place_ask
functions.doc:
Places a sealed ask (sell side). Tender or Exit: locks `units` of the caller's holding
 into the round (they keep accruing to the caller until `closes_at`); the sealed quantity
 must not exceed them. Advance: only the creator, `units` must equal the claim, and the
 sealed quantity must equal the claim. The bond `max(1 USDC, 1% of the units valued at
 max_price)` is taken from the caller's cash in the round venue. Attaches
 `BID_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`, refunded when the bid settles. One ask per account per round.
 Returns the bid id.

functions.name: place_bid
functions.doc:
Places a sealed bid (buy side) in an Exit or Advance round. `ciphertext_hex` is the
 192-byte IBE ciphertext of `(quantity, limit_price, salt)` encrypted to the round
 identity and bound to `(round_id, caller, side = Buy)`. `escrow` cash base units are taken
 from the caller's cash in the round venue, plus the bond `max(1 USDC, 1% of escrow)`. An
 Exit buyer must be registered with room for a holding row of the class, which the bid
 reserves until it settles.
 Attaches `BID_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`, refunded when the bid settles. One bid per account per
 round. Returns the bid id.

functions.name: quote_buy
functions.doc: Collateral a buyer needs for `quantity` at `limit_price` in `round_id`.

functions.name: quote_sell
functions.doc: Bond a seller posts to lock `units` in `round_id`.

functions.name: redeem
functions.doc:
Redeems a position in kind: burns its allocation `D_p` in class units from the caller's
 free units (units locked in rounds or encumbered by liens cannot be redeemed) and
 authorizes the release of the position to `to`; the position is `Releasing` meanwhile.
 On Base, a RoseVault `Release` (the vault withdraws the vested balance to itself first),
 final once signed. On Solana the caller also pays, from its own claimable tokens of the
 class, the stream's unlocked tokens not withdrawn yet (they belong to the unit holders and
 leave with the stream); the stream must carry no unconfirmed payout; `nonce` proves the
 durable nonce and receipt nonce accounts and `to`'s existing token account for the mint;
 the stream must be more than [`SOL_DRAW_CUTOFF_SECS`] from its end (Streamflow's
 auto-claim empties it at the end and its `transfer_recipient` then fails); the
 transaction is `[AdvanceNonce] + transfer_recipient(vault -> to) + [AdvanceNonce(receipt)]`
 and stays `Signed` until `confirm_sol_redeem` proves it executed (the burn is then
 final) or not (the units and the claimable tokens come back). Attach the payout storage
 deposit; 80 Tgas on Base, 200 Tgas on Solana.

functions.name: register_base_cash
functions.doc:
Registers a `CashDeposited` log of RoseVault: credits `amount` of `token` to
 `nearAccount`'s `Base(token)` venue. Every token is credited, so a deposit in a token the
 engine does not accept for rounds (or earmarked for a round that does not exist) is never
 lost: it can only leave again through `withdraw_base_cash`, since rounds refuse venues
 outside the accepted list. Anyone; attach exactly [`RECORD_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`] for the
 replay key, the credited account's cash row and, when it has none, its registration
 (kept; returned when the log is not attested) and 80 Tgas.

functions.name: register_base_deposit
functions.doc:
Registers a Sablier stream deposited into RoseVault (spec 7.1 step 3). The caller gives
 the receipt location of the `StreamDeposited` log and its decoded fields; the engine asks
 the MPC to attest the log at `Safe` finality and, in the callback, compares the attested
 payload hash with its own, checks the canonical lockup, non-cancelability and
 transferability, builds the class from the attested schedule and decimals, and mints
 `deposited` units to `nearAccount` from the deposit checkpoint. A genuine log the engine
 refuses is recorded so `return_refused_deposit` can send the stream back to its sender.
 Anyone; attach `registration_deposit_for(nearAccount, class)` (the records' storage,
 kept, plus the credited account's holder storage, whose unused part is returned; without
 a valid account or class, just [`RECORD_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`]) and 80 Tgas (after its own work
 the call keeps 50 Tgas for the proof and its 20 Tgas callback, so 50 attached fails). A
 failure on
 the MPC side (wrong values, unknown transaction, wrong log index, finality not reached)
 surfaces after about two minutes; the key is cleared, everything attached is returned and
 the call can be retried.

functions.name: register_sol_deposit
functions.doc:
Registers an attributed stream once it sits at the vault: proves the metadata account at
 `Finalized` (recipient = vault, eligibility flags, schedule equal to the class) and mints
 `net_amount_deposited` units to the attributed account from a checkpoint that excludes
 what the holder already withdrew. A proof showing the stream elsewhere than at the vault
 changes nothing (call again once the move executed); an ineligible stream at the vault is
 refused and returnable from the vault. Anyone; attach
 `registration_deposit_for(account, class)` (the records' storage, kept, plus the holder's
 storage, whose unused part is returned) and 80 Tgas.

functions.name: registration_deposit_for
functions.doc:
YoctoNEAR to attach to a deposit registration crediting `account` with units of
 `class_id`: the storage of the records it creates ([`RECORD_STORAGE_DEPOSIT`], kept) plus
 what `account` needs to hold the units (its registration or one more holding row; 0 when
 it already can), whose unused part is returned.

functions.name: resign_sol_gas
functions.doc:
Re-requests the `gas/sol` signature over the stored message of a payout whose vault
 signature exists. Anyone; about 50 Tgas.

functions.name: retry_base_signature
functions.doc:
Re-requests the `vault/base` signature of a Base authorization still `Requested`, once its
 last request failed or [`PENDING_EXPIRY_BLOCKS`] blocks after it (its callback ran out of
 gas): the same digest and id are signed again and nothing is debited. Anyone; attach

functions.name: retry_sol_payout
functions.doc:
Resolves a Solana action still `Requested` [`PENDING_EXPIRY_BLOCKS`] blocks after its
 last request (a callback ran out of gas), or at once when that request failed. Waiting
 for its proof: the request is abandoned and the debit refunded (nothing was signed).
 Signed with a recent blockhash (a move or a return): marked failed (nothing was debited,
 and the blockhash has expired; request the action again). Waiting for its durable-nonce
 signatures: the stored message (the original, or the nonce-advancing cancellation) is
 signed again. Anyone; about 100 Tgas.

functions.name: return_refused_deposit
functions.doc:
Sends a refused deposit back: on Base, signs `Release(lockup, streamId, to = sender, id)`;
 on Solana, signs `transfer_recipient` from where the stream sits (the vault or the
 deposit address) to the return address named at attribution, with the caller-supplied
 recent blockhash. Anyone; attach the payout storage deposit and about 60 Tgas (Base) or
 120 Tgas (Solana). On Base callable again only when the previous return failed; on Solana
 also once the previous one is signed (its blockhash may have expired).

functions.name: settle_bid
functions.doc:

 seller, refund of the unused escrow, bond refund or slash, and the storage deposit back to
 the bidder. Anyone, once the round is `Settled` or `Cancelled`; each bid settles once.

functions.name: submit_sol_signature

functions.name: sync_sol_stream
functions.doc:
Books what Streamflow withdrew from a held vault stream outside any engine payout: its
 auto-claim, which one second after a stream's end moves the remainder into the
 recipient's token account and closes the escrow, whatever `automatic_withdrawal` says
 (measured on devnet). One ForeignTx `AccountState` proof at `Finalized` of the metadata
 (`metadata_data`, read at `finalized`) showing the stream at the vault, paying the
 vault's token account, with `amount_withdrawn` above the engine's accounting: the
 difference is added to the class's swept balance (`get_sol_swept`), which payouts then
 pay out of the vault's token account, and `engine_withdrawn` catches up. A fully
 withdrawn stream is no longer drawn on. Refused while a payout drawing on the stream or
 its release is unsettled (nobody knows yet whether their transaction moved tokens), and
 re-checked in the callback. A lagging read shows less withdrawn, never more, so it books
 less or nothing and a later sync books the rest. Anyone; attach 80 Tgas.

functions.name: withdraw_base_cash
functions.doc:
Withdraws `amount` of the caller's Base cash in `token` to the EVM address `to` through a
 RoseVault `Transfer` authorization. Attach the payout storage deposit and 80 Tgas.

functions.name: withdraw_near_cash
functions.doc:
Withdraws `amount` of the caller's `Near` cash to its account through `ft_transfer`. The
 caller must be registered on the cash token; a failed transfer is credited back by the
 callback. The account is held until the callback, so its storage cannot leave before a
 credit-back lands. Anyone with cash; requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (forwarded to the token).

Nothing withdraws from a stream at its deposit address (only the engine holds that key, and the end is more than an hour away), so whatever a registration proof shows withdrawn beyond it was withdrawn after the move, into the vault's token account.

SolDraw.description: A Streamflow `withdraw` inside a payout transaction. While the payout is unconfirmed the amount is the stream's `pending_withdraw`; `expected_withdrawn` is the stream's attested `amount_withdrawn` once the transaction executed.

SolDrawArgs.description: One Streamflow withdrawal a Solana payout makes from a stream of its class, chosen by the claimant.

SolNonceProof.description:
The accounts a Solana payout or redeem is built on, proven together with one ForeignTx `AccountState` request at `Finalized` before anything is signed: the durable nonce account and the receipt nonce account (both owner System, authority = vault) and the recipient's associated token account for the mint (owner SPL Token, initialized, owned by the recipient), which must already exist so that the engine's fee payer never pays rent for it.

The transaction advances the durable nonce first and the receipt nonce last. A durable-nonce transaction that fails on chain still advances its durable nonce but rolls back every other instruction, the receipt's advance included, while one that executes leaves both accounts holding the same new value (both measured on devnet). So once the durable nonce moved, a receipt equal to it proves the transaction executed and a receipt behind it proves it did not, whatever happened to the streams, the vault's token account or the recipient's.

Both accounts belong to the calling NEAR account through their addresses: each must be `create_with_seed(base, seed, System program)` with a seed starting with the caller's prefix (`nonce_seed_prefix`), so nobody else can spend their nonce values.

anchor_tx.description: Anchor transaction (base58 signature): any successful finalized transaction not newer than the account reads.

base.description: The key both accounts were created from with a seed (base58; it signed the creations).

data.description: The 80 nonce account bytes (hex), read at `finalized`.

receipt_data.description: The 80 receipt nonce account bytes (hex), read at `finalized`.

receipt_seed.description: The seed of the receipt nonce account, from the same base and under the same rule; it must name another account than `seed`.

recipient_tokens_data.description: The 165 bytes of the recipient's associated token account (hex), read at `finalized`.

seed.description: The seed of the nonce account: the caller's 24-character prefix, then at most 8 characters of the caller's choice (so one wallet can hold several nonce accounts for one NEAR account).

SolStreamInfo.description: The accounts of a registered Streamflow position the engine needs to build instructions.

checkpoint.description: Accrual checkpoint the position's units were minted from.

drawing.description: The one payout drawing on the stream that is not confirmed yet (at most one at a time: until it is settled nobody knows whether its withdrawal happened, so the stream is not synced, redeemed or drawn on again).

engine_withdrawn.description: Tokens withdrawn from the stream's escrow and accounted for: the attested `amount_withdrawn` at registration, every payout withdrawal proven executed since, and what `sync_sol_stream` proved Streamflow withdrew into the vault's token account outside any payout (its auto-claim of an ended stream), booked in the class's swept balance.

escrow_tokens.description: Accounts of a Streamflow `withdraw`, as the attested metadata names them (the program requires them to match it).

pending_withdraw.description: What that payout withdraws (0 when none).

registered_withdrawn.description: The attested `amount_withdrawn` at registration (paid to the depositor before).

SolStreamState.description: A Solana stream of a class with what a payout can draw from it now, and the claimable tokens a redeem of its position would take now.

SolSwept.description: Tokens of a Solana class that Streamflow moved into the vault's token account outside any engine payout (its auto-claim of an ended stream), as `sync_sol_stream` proved them, and the part of them taken by payouts not confirmed yet.

balance.description: Booked and not paid out yet.

pending.description: Taken by payouts not confirmed yet (included in `balance`).

SolTransaction.description: A Solana legacy transaction the engine built, with its signatures as they arrive. Bytes are stored raw and rendered as base64 in JSON.

authority.description: Address (base58) of that authority, the key its signature verifies against.

authority_path.description: Derivation path of the authority that signs besides `gas/sol` (`vault/sol` or a deposit address path). The fee payer is always the first signature of the wire transaction.

cancel.description: The stored message only advances the nonce: the authority signature of the original message failed, and since a late signature of it could still surface, the payout is cancelled on chain (this message or the original executes, never both) and settled by its confirmation like any other.

draws.description: Streamflow withdrawals inside the message (payouts only), feeding the vault's token account with what the message pays out of it besides `swept`.

message.description: The compiled message every signer signs.

nonce_account.description: Nonce account and the value the message uses as its blockhash, for durable-nonce transactions (`None` with a recent blockhash).

not_executed_seen_at.description: Block of the first confirmation proof that showed the nonce advanced without the transaction's effects; the verdict "did not execute" needs another proof [`super::CONFIRM_FAILURE_DELAY_BLOCKS`] later, so a lagging read cannot produce it.

receipt_account.description: Receipt nonce account the message advances last (durable-nonce actions only; their nonce-only cancellation does not advance it): equal to the nonce account once the nonce moved, it proves the message executed (see [`SolNonceProof`]).

swept.description: What the payout takes from its class's swept balance (tokens Streamflow already moved into the vault's token account, booked by `sync_sol_stream`); 0 for other actions.

transaction.description: Wire transaction once both signatures exist, `[2] || sig(gas/sol) || sig(authority) || message`: assembled by the views, never stored.

Stats.description: Protocol statistics for the landing page.

volume_settled_usdc.description: Sum of settled notionals across every venue, in 6-decimal USDC-equivalent base units (every venue is a USDC: NEAR tUSDC, Base USDC or tUSDC).

max.description: Unbounded: an account pays one holding row per class it holds.

min.description: Deposit of a registration: the account record plus one holding row.

`sync_sol_stream` booked `amount` that Streamflow withdrew from a vault stream outside any payout (its auto-claim of an ended stream) in the class's swept balance.

predecessor.description: Account that called the method which produced the event.

seq.description: Sequence number, increasing from `0` over the whole life of the contract.

StreamDepositedFields.description: Decoded fields of a `StreamDeposited` log, as the app reads them from the receipt.

StreamflowScheduleArgs.description: Arguments of `compute_sol_class_id`: the stream's schedule, token amounts as `U64` strings.

budget.description: Budget, cash base units. The issuer escrows `budget + fee(budget)`.

max_price.description: Highest price per whole locked token the issuer pays.

retire_to.description: Foreign address receiving the retired units' unlocked tokens: an EVM address in any spelling (stored canonical) for a Base class, a base58 key for a Solana class. A burn address such as `0x…dead` is allowed; the zero address, RoseVault and the engine's own keys are refused.

owner_id.description: Always `None`: units are fungible within a class.

Venue.description: Cash venue of a round: every escrow, bond, fee and proceed of a round lives in its venue.

oneOf.description: The configured NEP-141 cash token on NEAR.
An accepted ERC-20 held by RoseVault on Base; `token` is the lowercase `0x` address.

VoidReason.description: Why an opened or unopened bid is void (its bond is slashed, it is never filled).

oneOf.description: Nobody opened it during the reveal window.
A buyer's `charge(limit, quantity) + fee` exceeds its escrow.
A buyer's quantity exceeds the round's `max_buy_quantity`: the class supply when the round was created (Exit), the claim (Advance).
A seller's quantity exceeds its locked units.
The Advance holder's ask quantity differs from the claim.
